name: Salem
source:
She was once a friend of Gii, studying at the same university.
Her personality was quiet, but she erupted at times. That intensity was like a flame.
She was getting into fights with difficult friends, wearing that white coat of hers... now there's no trace of that.
(Edited from in-game text)
